info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程依製造、固力、熱流、控制等四大領域，於上下學期分別進行，機械工程實驗(一)包含下列項目：1.射出成型與積層製造之原理與實作，並利用材料力學教授原理與拉伸測試儀量測物件之材料機械性質。2.電化學加工之理論與實驗應証，包括放電加工與線切割實際進行模型製作及表面粗糙度量測。3.應變片模組之校正實作，以常見的Arduino開發模組教授如何校正與測量物件之應變。4.光測彈性力學之原理與實作，結合自行設計之夾具與偏振光源求得材料應力。
description.describe_eh: The mechanical engineering lab courses include experiments in four main areas that are manufacturing, solid mechanics, heat and fluids mechanics and automatic control in a whole school year. The first semester covers the following experiments: 1. The principle of injection molding and additive manufacturing technologies. The implementation of mechanics of material knowledge in manufacturing and mechanical property measurement. 2. The principle of electrochemical machining includes electro discharge machining (EDM) and wire-cut EDM. The operation of the manufacturing techniques and utilize various measuring technique as a verification tool. 3. The principle of stain gauge and tension testing. The implementation of tensile testing machine and strain gauge module, by using Arduino board to calibrate and measure the strain of the material. 4. The principle of photoelasticity and mechanical design. The implementation of stress measurement and fixture designed.
